quote.translation: For example: "So, having been driven out, he descended to Torikami on the upper reaches of the Hi in the land of Izumo.

regions.text: の肥河上なる鳥髪の地に降りましき。

quote.translation: At this very time, chopsticks came floating down that river.

regions.text: この脚しお箸その河より流れ下りき。ここに須佐之男，命、その河上に人ありけうとおもほして求き上う往でまししかば、老夫と老女と二人在りて、童女を中に置ゑて泣くなり』（上^。

quote.translation: Susanoo, thinking there must be people upstream, went up in search of them, and there were an old man and an old woman, the two of them, weeping with a young girl set between them" (vol. 1).

regions.text: 「すなはち速須佐之男命その御個かせる十拳剣を投きて、その蛇を切り散りたまへば肥河血になりて流れき。

quote.translation: "Then Haya-Susanoo drew the ten-fist sword that he wore at his side and cut the serpent to pieces, and the river Hi turned to blood as it flowed.

regions.text: かれその中の尾を切りたまふ脚に、御刀の双毀けき。

quote.translation: Now, at the time he cut its middle tail, the edge of his sword broke.

regions.text: 怪しと思はして、毎刀の前あちて刺し制きて見そなばししかばつひがりの大刀あり。

quote.translation: Thinking this strange, he pierced and split the tail with the point of his sword and looked, and there was the great sword tsumugari.

regions.text: かれこの大刀を取らして異しき物ぞと思ほして、天照大御神に白し上げたまひき」（土巻）。

quote.translation: He took this great sword and, thinking it a wondrous thing, reported it to Amaterasu" (vol. 1).

regions.text: 『かれ木幅村に到りませる脚に、その衢に顔好き乙女遇へり。

quote.translation: "So at the time he arrived at the village of Kohata, he met a beautiful maiden at the crossroads.

regions.text: ここに天その乙女に、汝は維が子ぞと間はしければ答へ白さく、丸選之比布禮能意富美が女名は宮主矢河枝比賣とまをしき』（中^）。

quote.translation: The Emperor asked the maiden, 'Whose child are you?', and she answered, 'I am the daughter of Wani no Hifure no Ōmi, and my name is Miyanushi Yakawaehime'" (vol. 2).

regions.text: 経験的積極約供然は時間の地平にあつて周脚性または趣起性を成立規定に有つてある。

quote.translation: Empirical positive contingency, standing on the horizon of time, has simultaneity or succession as its constitutive determination.

regions.text: ミルが「偶然によつて同時に存在しまたは一が他に機起する」と云つたのはそのためである二一三六耳参照）。

quote.translation: This is why Mill spoke of things that "coexist, or one follows the other, by chance" (see p. 136).

regions.text: 云つたのはそのためである二一三六耳参照）。古事記

quote.translation: The three examples from the Kojiki are all simultaneous contingency.

regions.text: 古事記の例は三つとも同時偶然である。

quote.translation: There is also, however, successive contingency.

regions.text: なほ他に繼起約偶然もある。例へは周の武王が孟津に至って河を渡つ

quote.translation: That a white fish leapt into the boat when King Wu of Zhou reached Mengjin and crossed the river, and that a sea bass leapt into the boat when Kiyomori was at sea on his way to Kumano, together make up a successive contingency.
